ApplyBatchOut.title: ApplyBatchOut
ApplyBatchOut.description:
A batch and its result. ``status``: ``running`` (poll ``GET /pending/{id}``; steps not
reached yet are ``skipped``, ``not run yet``), ``finished`` (the result is final) or
``interrupted`` (a stop cut it off). ``stopped`` is set when GitHub stopped it (a rate
limit, with ``rate_limited_until``, or a rejected token). An interrupted or stopped batch is
resumed only with ``POST /pending/{id}/retry`` (its changes already left the tray); steps
already done are never repeated.

ApplyIssueOut.title: ApplyIssueOut
ApplyIssueOut.description:
One issue's steps in order: ``repo`` and ``n`` for an existing issue, ``temp_id`` for one
the batch creates (``repo`` and ``n`` filled once it exists).

ApplyRepoStepOut.title: ApplyRepoStepOut
ApplyRepoStepOut.description: A repo-level step: a label ensured (``label``) or an issue created (``temp_id``).

ApplyStepOut.title: ApplyStepOut
ApplyStepOut.description:
One step: ``done`` (``cause`` may say it was already so), ``failed`` or ``skipped``
(``cause`` says why). ``conflict``: it failed because GitHub changed underneath it (a parent
moved, a dimension filled, the issue closed), shown as a conflict, not overwritten.

CloseBody.title: CloseBody
CloseBody.description:
Close the issue; a duplicate names its original (which must be cached) and may carry a
comment, posted after the close.

source.title: Source
source.description: shared_file: a PR's finding on a file another PR also changes; agent: reported across PRs by the stack walkthrough

CrossFindingOut.title: CrossFindingOut
CrossFindingOut.description: A finding concerning more than one PR of a stack (agent text: render as text).

DoneIn.title: DoneIn
DoneIn.description: Optional: the round the author was shown (the PWA always sends it).

in_body.title: In Body
in_body.description: Read only: whether it posts in the review body (GitHub can't anchor it inline); null while GitHub's file list for the head isn't cached

DraftBody.title: DraftBody
DraftBody.description:
A draft review comment: inline (``line``, ``side`` and, for a range, ``start_line``
and ``start_side``) or ``outside_diff`` (posted in the review body).

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round the author was shown; refused with 409 RoundChanged once a newer round is current (the PWA always sends it)

files_pending.title: Files Pending
files_pending.description: GitHub's file list for the head isn't cached yet, so where each draft posts is unknown; the preview reads it

findings_pending.title: Findings Pending
findings_pending.description: the correctness pass or the findings job is still running; their drafts are added (next to the author's) when both have finished

seeds_dropped.title: Seeds Dropped
seeds_dropped.description: Finding drafts this save couldn't keep: a review takes at most 500 drafts, and the author's come first

url.title: Url
url.description: A feed URL, or a site that links one

IssueDetailOut.title: IssueDetailOut
IssueDetailOut.description:
One cached issue for the book layout. ``comments`` and ``timeline`` are what the last
refresh fetched (``details_synced_at``; ``None``: never); ``children`` is ``None`` while an
epic's sub-issues were never fetched.

IssueEventOut.title: IssueEventOut
IssueEventOut.description: A timeline event; ``source`` is the referencing issue or PR as ``owner/name#n``.

IssuePriorityRunOut.title: IssuePriorityRunOut
IssuePriorityRunOut.description:
A priority ask for a batch of issues: ``scope`` names the batch, ``status`` is
``running``, ``done`` (``suggestion_id`` is the draft), ``waiting`` (no agent runner; ask
again) or ``failed`` (``cause``).

IssueRowOut.title: IssueRowOut
IssueRowOut.description: An Inbox or Backlog row with its triage against the repo's schema.

IssueSuggestionEditIn.title: IssueSuggestionEditIn
IssueSuggestionEditIn.description:
The author's edit: the whole new ``payload`` for the suggestion's kind (see
``IssueSuggestionOut``), and optionally a new ``reason``.

IssueSuggestionOut.title: IssueSuggestionOut
IssueSuggestionOut.description:
A suggestion draft. ``repo`` and ``n`` name its issue (``scope`` a draft about several
issues or a queue, from later tasks). ``payload`` is Jesinia's own JSON, by ``kind``:

- ``label`` and ``new_area``: ``{dimension, value}`` (``new_area``: an area not in the
  schema yet, which approving adds);
- ``duplicate``: ``{repo, n, similarity}``; ``parent``: ``{repo, n}`` (the epic);
- ``readiness_gap``: ``{ready, missing}`` (``ready``: a ``human-needed`` issue could be
  ``agent-ready``; else what ``agent-ready`` still lacks);
- ``priority`` (about a batch, so ``scope``): ``{items: [{repo, n, priority, current, rank,
  reason}]}`` in rank order; ``priority`` is the schema value to set (``null``: none), and
  ``current`` the priority the issue had, which approving applies against. After an
  approval each item also has ``outcome: {state, cause}``: ``applied``, ``failed`` or
  ``skipped`` (not applied, with the cause; the next approval tries only these) or
  ``unchanged`` (nothing to set). The draft is ``approved`` once every item is applied or
  unchanged; until then ``apply_error`` lists what applied and what didn't.

``reason`` is the agent's one line, untrusted text shown as data. ``apply_error`` is why
its last approval didn't apply (it stays approvable).

IssueSuggestionRunIn.title: IssueSuggestionRunIn
IssueSuggestionRunIn.description:
Issues to suggest for now (usually from the Backlog, which never gets suggestions in the
background).

IssueSuggestionRunOut.title: IssueSuggestionRunOut
IssueSuggestionRunOut.description:
An issue's latest suggestion run: ``queued`` (until ``due_at``), ``running``, ``done``,
``skipped`` (it left the Inbox first), ``waiting`` (no runner; manual triage works) or
``failed`` (``cause``). ``source``: ``inbox`` (background) or ``demand``.

IssueSuggestionsOut.title: IssueSuggestionsOut
IssueSuggestionsOut.description:
Suggestions, oldest first; ``run`` is the issue's latest run when one issue was asked
for, ``priority_run`` the latest priority ask when a batch ``scope`` was.

IssueViewOut.title: IssueViewOut
IssueViewOut.description: A list served from the cache at once; the sync's state is reported, never awaited.

IssuesErrorOut.title: IssuesErrorOut
IssuesErrorOut.description:
A typed error: its class name, the cause, and (when GitHub rate limited the request)
the seconds to wait, also sent as ``Retry-After``.

IssuesRepoIn.title: IssuesRepoIn
IssuesRepoIn.description:
Settings → Issues for one repo. PUT replaces, so ``settings_schema`` is required: send
the schema to keep, or an explicit ``null`` to clear it (the default then applies when there
is no labels.yml). Leaving it out is a 422, never a silent wipe of the author's schema.

IssuesRepoOut.title: IssuesRepoOut
IssuesRepoOut.description:
A repo the author added. ``label_schema`` is the effective one and ``schema_source`` where
it came from: ``repo`` (its ``.jesinia/labels.yml``, which wins while it exists),
``settings`` (``settings_schema``) or ``default``. ``schema_errors`` lists what labels.yml
couldn't use.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags for the page; one not in the catalog yet is added to it

takeaway.description: From Engage: written to the page's AI section

created.title: Created
created.description: False when the source's page existed and was updated

LabelApplyIn.title: LabelApplyIn
LabelApplyIn.description: Apply a previewed plan (an approval). ``plan_id`` is the preview's.

LabelApplyOut.title: LabelApplyOut
LabelApplyOut.description:
What an apply did, step by step. ``note`` says why old labels were kept;
``stopped`` is set when GitHub stopped the batch (a rate limit, with
``rate_limited_until`` and ``Retry-After``, or a rejected token): the response is then a 503.
Anything left needs a fresh preview.

LabelCanonicalBody.title: LabelCanonicalBody
LabelCanonicalBody.description: A canonical label value and the existing labels that mean the same thing.

LabelOpOut.title: LabelOpOut
LabelOpOut.description:
One step: ``create`` (``name``, ``color``, ``description``) or ``delete`` (``name``).
A delete with a ``replacement`` first moves every issue and pull request carrying the label
to it (listed live at apply time); ``members`` is what the preview listed. ``skip_cause``
says why the step will be skipped whatever happens (a name GitHub can't list by).

LabelPlanOut.title: LabelPlanOut
LabelPlanOut.description: A previewed batch: apply it with ``plan_id`` before ``expires_at``.

LabelStepOut.title: LabelStepOut
LabelStepOut.description: A step's outcome; ``failed_issues`` are the issues a delete's moves failed on.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A PR URL, owner/repo#n, or a /review/<owner>/<repo>/<n> link

revs.title: Revs
revs.description: Page id → rev, from the previews

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.description: Generate the quiz, which is off on your own PR (spec §3.3)

OpenIn.title: OpenIn
OpenIn.description:
What the author asks of opening (both optional): their ``depth`` in place of
Jesinia's proposal, or ``walk_everything`` to walk the rest of the change too.

OpenOut.title: OpenOut
OpenOut.description:
What opening did: ``started`` jobs (202), or the round's state, or the gate holding
it (``ci_failing``…, with **Review anyway** offered).

PendingApplyIn.title: PendingApplyIn
PendingApplyIn.description: Which staged changes to apply (all of them when ``ids`` is omitted or ``null``).

PendingIn.title: PendingIn
PendingIn.description: A change to stage for a cached issue, and what staged it.

PendingListOut.title: PendingListOut
PendingListOut.description: The tray, in the order staged.

PostAllIn.title: PostAllIn
PostAllIn.description: Post all (spec §4.3): every PR's confirmed review, posted bottom-up.

PostAllItemIn.title: PostAllItemIn
PostAllItemIn.description: One PR's confirmed review: its round, event, preview digest and confirmed warnings.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: The digest of the preview being confirmed

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round the author was shown; refused with 409 RoundChanged once a newer round is current (the PWA always sends it)

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as ``before`` for the next page

PrFileOut.title: PrFileOut
PrFileOut.description:
A changed file as GitHub lists it; ``patch`` (the file's unified diff hunks, PR
content) is null when GitHub doesn't show it (binary, or too large).

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: The round's artifacts by kind (agent output is the PR's to influence)

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: The PR has moved past the head this review covers

files.title: Files
files.description: GitHub's cached files of the round's head, for the walkthrough's diff; null before any round or while that head's list isn't cached

PrOut.title: PrOut
PrOut.description: An opened PR from the cache: its row, its latest round and every artifact of it.

round_id.title: Round Id
round_id.description: The round the author was shown; refused with 409 RoundChanged once a newer round is current (the PWA always sends it)

pr_head_sha.title: Pr Head Sha
pr_head_sha.description: The PR's head on GitHub now (newer_head names it)

PreviewOut.title: PreviewOut
PreviewOut.description: Exactly what posting ``event`` sends; pass ``digest`` back to post it.

QueueOut.title: QueueOut
QueueOut.description: The cached queue; a running or failed sync is reported here, never by waiting.

nothing_to_walk.title: Nothing To Walk
nothing_to_walk.description: The latest review's diff changes no line: show that, not 100%

followup_kind.title: Followup Kind
followup_kind.description: What this head needs after the author's previous review (spec §4.1): still_approved, changed_hunks_only, rereview or new; null until classified

followup_note.title: Followup Note
followup_note.description: One line on it, in Jesinia's words

differing_paths.title: Differing Paths
differing_paths.description: Files whose changes differ from the previous review's (PR text)

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: The PR's stack (spec §4.3) as PR numbers, bottom-up; empty if none

recommendation_label.title: Recommendation Label
recommendation_label.description: The recommendation in words; on your own PR, 'ready to request review' or 'not ready to request review' (spec §3.3)

QueueRowOut.title: QueueRowOut
QueueRowOut.description: A queue row (spec §2 "Each row shows"); ``title`` is the PR author's text.

post_id.title: Post Id
post_id.description: The selected post: it and every post above it are marked

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: When the client loaded the list (ISO 8601 with offset): posts first seen later were never on screen and stay unread

revs.title: Revs
revs.description: Page id → rev, from the preview

ReorderChildBody.title: ReorderChildBody
ReorderChildBody.description: Within this epic, move ``child`` just after ``after`` (the top when ``null``).

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: For NeedsConfirmation: every warning to confirm

review_url.title: Review Url
review_url.description: For EarlierReviewPosted: the review GitHub already has

successor_round_id.title: Successor Round Id
successor_round_id.description: For RoundFrozen: the round that took over its drafts

retry_after.title: Retry After
retry_after.description: For PostingStillUncertain and PostingInProgress: seconds before retrying (also the Retry-After header)

stack_outcomes.title: Stack Outcomes
stack_outcomes.description: For a Post all that stopped: what was and wasn't posted, per PR (the error is the PR's that stopped it)

frozen.title: Frozen
frozen.description: Read-only: a round on the PR's new head took over its drafts

near.title: Near
near.description: For NearDuplicate: the existing tags it is close to

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags for the note; one not in the catalog yet is added to it

SetDimensionBody.title: SetDimensionBody
SetDimensionBody.description: Set readiness, priority or type to a schema value (its other values are removed).

SetParentBody.title: SetParentBody
SetParentBody.description:
Make ``parent`` the issue's epic, or remove its parent (``null``). In the tray,
``expects_parent`` and ``expected_parent`` show the parent it was staged against (a move on
GitHub since is a conflict). Staging records them from the cache and ignores what is sent.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Days an unkept post is kept after publication

source_folder.title: Source Folder
source_folder.description: The KB folder kept posts are written to

StackOpenIn.title: StackOpenIn
StackOpenIn.description: ``retry``: run again the stack's jobs that failed.

StackOpenOut.title: StackOpenOut
StackOpenOut.description:
What opening the stack did: each PR's open, and the stack's jobs (``held`` while a PR
is held by a gate).

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: The stack review's artifacts by kind (agent output: render as text)

StackOut.title: StackOut
StackOut.description:
A stack from the cache (spec §4.3): each PR's own view bottom-up, the stack review of
their current heads and its artifacts (overview, background, stack_walkthrough, jobs),
and the cross-PR findings.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to tag (title, note, excerpt)

SuggestionApproveOut.title: SuggestionApproveOut
SuggestionApproveOut.description:
The suggestion after its approval (``approved``, or still open with ``apply_error``) and
the batch that applied it.

new.title: New
new.description: Not in the catalog yet; accepting it creates it

force.title: Force
force.description: Add even though near-matches exist (user override)

text.title: Text
text.description: The takeaway as the author left it

session.title: Session
session.description: The Engage session it came from
